correctness.rationale: The bridge induction enforces every finite sliding-product upper bound, repeated Wallen prefixes attain each prescribed value infinitely far out, weakly null basis vectors force the corresponding essential-norm lower bounds, and positivity of all weights gives irreducibility.

originality.rationale: The ordinary norm realization is explicitly classical Wallen and is not claimed as new. Targeted searches found no source giving the simultaneous operator/essential power-norm realization by an irreducible weighted shift or the resulting exact essential-spectral-radius rate theorem; incompletely inspected classical weighted-shift sources remain a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result upgrades a classical power-norm realization to an exact Calkin-norm realization without sacrificing irreducibility and yields arbitrary exact convergence rates for both spectral-radius formulas, including non-power-compact irreducible Riesz examples.
